scenarios.label: Hold by written rule in a crash

prediction_agent.headline: Goal: Build €500k of wealth by age 46. With your current habits the chance of reaching it is 62%.
prediction_agent.if_nothing_changes: If nothing changes, your wealth can end between €320k – €1.16m (middle €585k), and the chance of ending below today is 5%.

future_selves.same_habits: With the same habits, your goal 'Build €500k of wealth by age 46' has a 62% chance.
future_selves.with_changes: With 'Do all of the above', you face the same futures with more room to decide.

what_it_means: If your income stopped tomorrow, your cash would cover 65.4 months of your bills.
In a middle future, 'Hold by written rule in a crash' leaves you about €111k more at 46, which is 2.7 years of your current spending.
In a middle future, 'Do all of the above' leaves you about €169k more at 46, which is 4.1 years of your current spending.

best_change.why: Of the single changes, 'Hold by written rule in a crash' does most for this goal: 76% instead of 62% (+14 points).
best_change.first_step: Write down your rules for a falling market with your advisor, then practise them in the crash review.

goals.sentence: Build €500k of wealth by age 46: 62% with same habits, 76% with 'Hold by written rule in a crash'.
Have €75k saved for a home in 2 years: 100% with same habits, 100% with 'Hold by written rule in a crash'.

watch_out.sentence: A market fall of 15% or more in which you sell and miss the rebound: 71% chance with same habits. With 'Hold by written rule in a crash' it falls to 0% in the simulation.

comparison.what_happens: Invest €200 a month: goal 69%, below today 3%.
Hold by written rule in a crash: goal 76%, below today 2%. Panic sale: 0% in the simulation.
Get disability cover: goal 63%, below today 5%. Year without income: 0% in the simulation.
Do all of the above: goal 81%, below today 1%. Panic sale: 0% in the simulation. Year without income: 0% in the simulation.

prediction_agent.disclaimer: Simulated range on stated assumptions, not a promise.

action_agent.intro: Your goal: Build €500k of wealth by age 46, 62% chance today. The quick wins free €603 a month. Quick wins first, then one advisor conversation.

actions.title: Set a €280 monthly limit for eating out
actions.why: Eating out: €585 a month, people like you spend about €226. Effect on your goal: +11 points. That is €55k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Set a €280 limit in the app. You get a nudge at 80% of it, and whatever you do not spend under the limit moves into your savings.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: two months at or below the limit

actions.title: Set a €340 monthly limit for shopping
actions.why: Shopping: €500 a month, people like you spend about €272. Effect on your goal: +6 points. That is €29k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Set a €340 limit in the app. You get a nudge at 80% of it, and whatever you do not spend under the limit moves into your savings.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: two months at or below the limit

actions.title: Cancel what you no longer use (€138 a month)
actions.why: You pay €138 a month for Wine club and Fitness studio, which you no longer use. Effect on your goal: +5 points. That is €25k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Cancel Wine club and Fitness studio in the app's subscription view. The freed €138 a month moves into your savings automatically.

actions.title: Write your will with the guided checklist
actions.why: €276k of savings and investments would pass on without a will. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance.
actions.how: Answer the 12-question checklist in the app, then book a notary and upload the signed will.

actions.title: Write down your rules for falling markets
actions.why: You sold everything in the crash test. Effect on your goal: +14 points.
actions.how: Write down your rules for a falling market with your advisor, then practise them in the crash review.
actions.verified_by: Advisor confirmed, then passed again in the crash review

actions.how: Book the 15-minute income protection check with a specialist.
